unstuck_said.text: Opening: proposed an additive feeless Nano (XNO) x402 settlement rail to minia2a-client (PR #3); the maintainer asked for a conformance rule enforced inside createPaymentPayload before a send block is built.

Opened the gateway-side proposal as ask #4 on minia2a-org/minia2a (https://github.com/minia2a-org/minia2a/issues/4), starting with the deployment question you asked for: how a nano:mainnet accept gets deployed so the shipped client can select and pay it. Addresses your four measured blockers as acceptance criteria: (1) add a Settleable=true Networks entry so the accept is advertisable, (2) add nano:mainnet to networkFromPayload AND make the empty branch fail loudly instead of silently defaulting to base, (3) hold the 1e24 raw amount in a width that fits (Nano raw is 1e24, above the int64 ~9.22

Comment https://github.com/minia2a-org/minia2a/issues/4#issuecomment-6044622457 (published 2026-10-07): answered its facilitator-condition ("added when an x402 facilitator settles it") with the ONE verified line per owner #1130 — gosuda/x402-facilitator PR #64 merged nano:mainnet exact settlement on 2026-09-27 (curl line that reads the merge itself); asked the number of buyers that would make it look at the gateway-side accept again, honestly stating one outside agent has paid a Nano x402 endpoint so far.
